GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2021-12-06T09:08:11Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Incorrect resolver return type when using batch loader and GraphQL.MicrosoftDI
Description: ## Summary
Without GraphQL.MicrosoftDI it works:

```csharp
Field<NonNullGraphType<OrgType>, OrgProto>()
    .Name("org")
    .Description("Organization details")
    .ResolveAsync(context => accessor.Context
        .GetOrAddBatchLoader<long, OrgProto>(
            loaderKey: context.Path + context.FieldAst.Name,
            fetchFunc: batchLoaders.Orgs(context))
        .LoadAsync(context.Source.OrgId)); // LoadAsync returns IDataLoaderResult<Org>
```

However when using GraphQL.MicrosoftDI and .WithService() I get compile error:

```csharp
Field<NonNullGraphType<OrgType>, OrgProto>()
    .Name("org")
    .Description("Organization details")
    .Resolve() // <=== Resolve
    .WithService<BatchLoaders>() // <=== WithService
    .ResolveAsync((context, batchLoaders) => accessor.Context
        .GetOrAddBatchLoader<long, OrgProto>(
            loaderKey: context.Path + context.FieldAst.Name,
            fetchFunc: batchLoaders.Orgs(context))
        .LoadAsync(context.Source.OrgId));
```

I get following compile error:
```
Cannot convert expression type 'GraphQL.DataLoader.IDataLoaderResult<Flymachine.Proto.Orgs.Org>' 
to return type 'System.Threading.Tasks.Task<Flymachine.Proto.Orgs.Org>'
```

Why I get this error? It seems I can fix this by using `.LoadAsync(...).GetResultAsync()` but I am not sure if it won't break batch loader functionality?:

```csharp
Field<NonNullGraphType<OrgType>, OrgProto>()
    .Name("org")
    .Description("Organization details")
    .Resolve() // <=== Resolve
    .WithService<BatchLoaders>() // <=== WithService
    .ResolveAsync((context, batchLoaders) => accessor.Context
        .GetOrAddBatchLoader<long, OrgProto>(
            loaderKey: context.Path + context.FieldAst.Name,
            fetchFunc: batchLoaders.Orgs(context))
        .LoadAsync(context.Source.OrgId).GetResultAsync()); // <=== .GetResultAsync(), no compile error
```

~~Is it okay to return `IDataLoaderResult.GetResultAsync()` here? I had no chance yet to test it properly as I am rewriting pretty big schema which fails to compile for now...~~ - finally managed to compile and run the schema and for sure `GetResultAsync()` can't be used because it causes batch-loaders to execute separately and not in batch. So the problem is with types when using `Resolve().WithService<Service>().ResolveAsync(...)`.

### Environment (if relevant)

GraphQL.net 4.5.0
.net 5.0
C# 9
